title: दत्तात्रेय के साथ चार कुत्ते क्यों? 🐕 | देवताओं के वाहन क्यों? भाग 7
caption:
तीन देवों का एक रूप, पीछे गाय, पैरों के पास चार कुत्ते। परंपरा कहती है ये चार वेद हैं। 🙏
सीरीज़ कैसी लगी? 👇
sources: Dattatreya iconography in the Maharashtra and Karnataka traditions (the four dogs as the four Vedas, the cow as the earth/Kamadhenu), told as tradition
Bhagavata Purana 11.7-9 (the Avadhuta and his twenty-four gurus: earth, water, bee, child and others)
